entries.a41665ced90babfe: A system in which a person entrusts their property to a trusted person or company (the trustee), who manages and invests it for themselves or for someone they care about, in line with a determined purpose.
entries.ffe2dbe3cbf35598: A system in which a person entrusts their property to a trusted person or company (the trustee), who manages and invests it for themselves or for someone they care about, in line with a determined purpose. Trust banks and similar institutions act as trustees and take on the management and investment of the property.
